F2. The ngx-features RR recipe (compile + --rr-oracle-dir invocation) is not written in any of the three scoped docs. F6. The FG native control output (native-frame-N.bin) is not consumed by check-owned-fg-capture.py: the checker has no native input path (only the refused --native at :374/:392). The FG native control is therefore a standalone oracle receipt, not an input to the automated FG gate.
